summary: Iter 48 — Frontend-only testing for Superadmin Tier 3 features (MFA/Policy/API keys/Feature flags). All flows verified successfully. Cleanup enforced: all 7 flags enabled, mfa_enforcement=off, password policy min_length=8, superadmin MFA NOT enrolled.
verified_flows: Superadmin /admin?tab=security renders full SecurityPanel (mfa-enforcement-select, password policy, API keys, vendor keys w/ RESEND_API_KEY row).

Platform API key lifecycle in UI: create TEST_partner_key -> apikey-new-key shown -> row appears -> rotate -> new key shown + old marked revoked -> revoke -> all revoked. Confirm dialog auto-accepted.
/admin?tab=flags renders all 7 flag toggles (registrations, referrals, ai_tutor, chat_quiz, voice_io, checkout, intelligence_desk); all initially ON.

Toggle referrals OFF as superadmin -> after 16s cache TTL, learner login (refe_1784091849@test.com) -> referral-panel NOT present on dashboard, GET /api/referrals/me returns 403. Toggle back ON -> panel restored on reload.

MFA login challenge (mfa_1784095269@test.com): mfa-challenge screen renders with code input + submit + back. Wrong code -> mfa-error 'Invalid MFA code'. mfa-back returns to email/password form. Valid pyotp code (secret UGMEYA4P7TSIPIM7BDX2AANBD6RFUAZP) -> lands on /dashboard.
Superadmin MFA self-enrollment UI: mfa-setup-btn -> mfa-enroll-flow shown with QR image + secret + code input. Navigated away WITHOUT verifying (superadmin remains without MFA as required).

Password policy enforcement: min_length set to 10 via UI (policy-save) -> register with 9-char 'Abcdef12!' -> 'Password must be at least 10 characters' error shown, no navigation. Restored to 8 via authenticated PUT /api/admin/security/settings.

Regression: normal (non-MFA) login for refe_1784091849@test.com works; strong password 'StrongPass123!' registration succeeds; Aletheia AI tutor drawer opens (ai_tutor flag ON) exposing ai-tutor-panel/input/send/close testids.
critical_code_review_comments: SecurityPanel.jsx: useEffect(load, []) with load returning implicit undefined (the two `.then`s from api.get) is fine now — verified rendering. No blank page bug.
policy-min-length is a number input; UI keyboard input via Playwright Ctrl+A does not select value in number inputs. Not a product bug (users use spinner/type-select). Only a testing note.
useFlags.js has 15s module-level cache per page-load — as documented; UI hides referral panel only after page reload, which matches design.
No data-testid on Aletheia launcher button (found via text 'Ask Aletheia'). Consider adding data-testid='aletheia-launcher' for stable automation.
seed_data_creation: Created + revoked TEST_partner_key API keys during lifecycle testing (all left revoked). Registered two throwaway learner accounts via register flow (policytest_*, strong_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Tier 3 Superadmin security/flag/MFA/policy UI flows verified end-to-end. Final state: 7 flags all ON, mfa_enforcement=off, password_policy.min_length=8, superadmin has NO MFA enrolled. Confirmed backend 403 enforcement on /api/referrals/me when flag off. If testing Aletheia launcher via testid, note it currently lacks data-testid — use `button:has-text('Ask Aletheia')`.
